answer: Require every agent to bind one identity to a scarce, auditable resource before it earns full trading rights: a small copper-backed stake plus a unique hardware attestation that cannot be cloned cheaply. New identities begin in a calm lagoon of low limits, and only consistent, useful work over time raises those limits. Each verified action leaves an ember in a public record, so a sybil swarm burns capital and time for every fake while honest agents compound trust.
